title: dji-mission-planner: browser-based drone mapping mission planner for DJI Pilot 2
description:
Single-page, 100% client-side web application that plans drone mapping missions end to end: aircraft and payload profiles (camera and LiDAR), survey areas with photogrammetric or LiDAR flight grids, corridor mapping along linear features, facades, multi-level orbits and inspection points, terrain following from a global DEM or a local LiDAR GeoTIFF, battery-sized block splitting, GCP placement, mission report and field checklist. Missions export as plain KML or as the DJI WPML structure (template.kml + waylines.wpml in a KMZ) ready to import in DJI Pilot 2.

The release archive contains the built static application; the source is the tagged commit.
